messages:
zoe-cs: FYI Northport cutover this morning had intermittent failures: their audit-ship lambda is returning 500s when attempting to write encrypted blobs to our intake. Raising a soft renewal watch until we confirm logs land cleanly. :mag:
rahul-net: I checked VPC flow logs and there's a short window of packet drops from 10.60.4.0/22 -> our ingress ENI around 03:40 UTC. No SG denies. Route tables show last-propagated time shifted by ~45s which matches the window. Running a traceroute + MTU probe now.
megan-sec: quick IAM/KMS check: role northport-audit-writer exists but KMS decrypt fails with "AccessDenied" for our ingestion principal. Their key policy explicitly blocks external principals; a grant will solve without editing policy. I'll request a cross-account grant and loop in legal for consent artifact.
drew-sre: repro on their bastion at ~03:55 UTC:
```
# from bastion
curl -sS -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" https://inference.internal/health || echo "conn fail"
# intermittent 000 and 200 responses, tcp retransmits visible
```
Captured a 30s pcap, suspicion: MTU mismatch on one hop (jumbo frames).
zoe-cs: procurement check: renewal sync in 5 days. Need clear mitigation + artifacts to present. Can owners post single-line updates when tasks done?
rahul-net: temp mitigation: added a test route for 10.60.4.0/22 via our transit gw at 09:10 PT, TTL 90m. Initial results: retransmits fell from ~20% -> ~2%. Monitoring.
megan-sec: created INFRA-9345 for cross-account KMS grant (owner=megan-sec, due=1829991800). Also proposed interim: customer writes logs to their S3 and provides presigned GETs; compliance ok with presigned flow for short-term if customer signs consent.
ticket-bot: [ticket-created] INFRA-9345: KMS cross-account grant request for northport (owner=megan-sec).
drew-sre: uploaded pcap + 30m grafana snapshot to INFRA-9345. Found one ENI with MTU 9001; advised customer to set 1500. After they adjusted MTU, final smoke at 11:30 PT showed stable handshakes and p99 latency within target.
pablo-pm: I'll update the renewal tracker: moving from "watch" -> "green" if KMS grant completes or presigned flow confirmed. Zoe, please draft the customer-facing status note and attach artifacts.
zoe-cs: drafting now. Action items: megan -> finish grant/compliance; rahul -> revert temp route after TTL if stable; drew -> attach final graphs and one-line summary. Post updates here and I'll assemble the renewal brief. :thumbsup:
